thread:
maya: FYI a strategic customer asked for per-route optimization advice (batching, cache, quant) plus eval-triggered alerts. They want a visible console panel and a pilot path. Thoughts on prioritizing this for next quarter?

samir: priority depends on ROI signal. do we have estimates for cost savings across typical routes?

elaine: customer calls repeatedly call out two things: (1) clear, human-readable recs per route, (2) alerts when quality drifts post-change. They want transparency 60.

roberto: engineering: runtime can export token-level latency/cost aggregates and KV-hit stats but needs a small schema change and an exporter. ballpark 2-3 weeks for Phase 0 telemetry. auto-apply is more work.

maya: proposed phased approach: Phase 0 = "advice only" console (read-only recs from offline analysis + eval linkage). Phase 1 = one-click apply that creates a canary with preflight evals. Phase 2 = automated rollouts + eval-triggered rollback/alerts.

anika: devex: Phase 0 should include an SDK endpoint and sample app so pilots can consume recs programmatically. docs + sample in first week after cut.

samir: must include acceptance tests: any quant recommendation requires running a small eval suite to check embeddings/text metric delta before applying.

roberto: suggested Phase 1 pilot gates: either >=10% median token-cost reduction for top 20% of pilot routes OR >=5 cust alerts caught by evals within 30 days. require no SLO regressions during canary and ability to revert within 5 minutes.

elaine: product acceptance: recs must show expected cost delta and risk summary, pre/post eval reports available to customers, and audit logs for each action.

maya: risks: quantization can reduce quality; caching changes can affect freshness. we need clear disclaimers and opt-out per-route.

prod-bot: poll by maya: "Approve phased advice -> apply roadmap" 60 voting window 48h.

roberto: action: scope telemetry change and exporter by Mon EOD.

anika: action: SDK hooks sketch + sample CLI by Wed.

ops-team: action: shortlist 4-6 pilot customers and share contacts by Fri.

samir: :thumbsup: add explicit QA window for quant recs (preflight + staged validation).

maya: I'll draft PRD and share link. please react if you endorse or drop comments. Thanks!
